title: Koko Eating Bananas

statement.hi: `n` dher (piles) me bananas hain, `piles[i]` bananas `i`-th dher me. Koko ek speed `k` (bananas/hour) chunti hai: har ghante woh ek dher se `k` bananas khaati hai; dher me `k` se kam hon to sab kha leti hai aur us ghante aur nahi khaati. Sabse chhota integer `k` return karo jisse woh `h` ghanton me saare bananas kha le.
statement.en: There are `n` piles of bananas, the `i`-th pile has `piles[i]` bananas. Koko picks an eating speed `k` (bananas per hour): each hour she picks one pile and eats `k` bananas from it; if the pile has fewer than `k`, she eats all of it and nothing more that hour. Return the minimum integer `k` such that she can eat all the bananas within `h` hours.

hi: Speed `k` pe total ghante = sum of `ceil(piles[i] / k)`. `k` badhne pe ye kabhi nahi badhta.
Isliye answer `k` pe binary search karo, range `[1, max(piles)]`.
en: At speed `k` the total hours are the sum of `ceil(piles[i] / k)`, which never increases as `k` grows.
So binary search on the answer `k` over `[1, max(piles)]`.

explain.hi: Har dher ke liye ek hi ghanta hai, isliye `k` = sabse bada dher = 30.
explain.en: One hour per pile, so `k` must be the largest pile, 30.

approach.hi: Answer pe binary search: `lo = 1`, `hi = max(piles)`. `mid` speed pe ghante gino (`(p + mid - 1) / mid` ka sum, `long long` me). `≤ h` ho to `mid` chal jaayega → `hi = mid`, warna `lo = mid + 1`. O(n log(max)) time, O(1) space.
approach.en: Binary search on the answer: `lo = 1`, `hi = max(piles)`. Count hours at speed `mid` (sum of `(p + mid - 1) / mid`, in `long long`). If `≤ h`, `mid` works → `hi = mid`, else `lo = mid + 1`. O(n log(max)) time, O(1) space.
